dialogue.oldrepublic.vendor_watch_quarte: What does it take to buy the plate?
The Watch's stores are open to friends of the Watch. Battle plate, practice blades, thread and shards for those who make their own.
Trust. The battle plate and its patterns go to those the Watch calls Trusted, and so does the staff grip. Help the Keeper, take the terminal's work, and it will come.
I don't sell to the Empire's students. Not here, not in this hall.
dialogue.oldrepublic.vendor_imperial_qua: What does it take to buy the plate?
Requisitions are open. War plate, practice blades with a proper colour, plate stock and silk. Sign here, pay there.
Standing. War plate and its patterns go to those the Empire calls Trusted. The electrostaff goes only to the Honoured. Earn it at the terminal or in the tombs.
The Order's people buy nothing here. Walk on before someone writes your name down.
dialogue.oldrepublic.vendor_spacer.opt.t: My ship is down somewhere on this world. Can you tow it in?
dialogue.oldrepublic.vendor_spacer.opt.r: My hull's seen better days. Can you patch it up?
dialogue.oldrepublic.vendor_spacer.opt.a: Any advice for a new pilot?
dialogue.oldrepublic.vendor_spacer.greet: Fuel, parts, plating, and the odd jacket. Everything costs more out here, because out here is where you need it.
dialogue.oldrepublic.vendor_spacer.advic: Carry a spare cell. Fix the hull before you jump, not after. And never land where you would not want to walk home from.
dialogue.oldrepublic.trainer_armstech.op: I want to give up Armstech.
dialogue.oldrepublic.trainer_armstech.gr: Blasters, blades and what goes inside them. I teach the trade to anyone who will learn it, and I sell the best patterns to those who already have.
dialogue.oldrepublic.trainer_armstech.un: You will lose your level and every pattern you learned in it, and the lesson has a fee. The bench remembers nothing. Are you sure?
dialogue.oldrepublic.trainer_armstech.ab: Armstech is the making of weapons: blaster bodies, barrels, cells, vibro edges, grenades. Get good and you will make guns that do not jam when it matters.
dialogue.oldrepublic.trainer_armourcraft: I want to give up Armourcraft.
Plate, padding and the straps between. Anyone can wear armour; few can make it fit.
You will lose your level and every pattern you learned in it, and the lesson has a fee. The bench remembers nothing. Are you sure?
Armourcraft is the making of armour, ship plating and the mods that sit in them. A good smith makes plate that turns a blade and still lets you run.
dialogue.oldrepublic.trainer_artifice.op: I want to give up Artifice.
dialogue.oldrepublic.trainer_artifice.gr: Lenses, conduits and grips. The fine work, the work the Force notices.
dialogue.oldrepublic.trainer_artifice.un: You will lose your level and every pattern you learned in it, and the lesson has a fee. The bench remembers nothing. Are you sure?
dialogue.oldrepublic.trainer_artifice.ab: Artifice is the making of saber parts and attuned things: lenses, staff grips, conduits, the cells that feed them. Patience matters more than strength.
dialogue.oldrepublic.trainer_medtech.opt: I want to give up Medtech.
dialogue.oldrepublic.trainer_medtech.gre: Medpacs, stims and the tools that keep a body going. I teach anyone. Bleeding is not political.
dialogue.oldrepublic.trainer_medtech.unl: You will lose your level and every pattern you learned in it, and the lesson has a fee. The bench remembers nothing. Are you sure?
dialogue.oldrepublic.trainer_medtech.abo: Medtech is the making of medpacs, injectors, stims and field tools like the scanner and the fusion cutter. Every crew needs one.
dialogue.oldrepublic.apprentice.greet: Keeper Ansa says I swing like I'm chopping wood. Want to show me how it's done? Training blades only.
dialogue.oldrepublic.apprentice.contract: The terminal says you're here for a bout. I won't go easy on you.
dialogue.oldrepublic.apprentice.wary: The Keeper says to be polite to you. I'm being polite. If you want a bout, I'll give you one.
dialogue.oldrepublic.acolyte.greet: The drill yard is open. Lose to me and I tell everyone. Win and I tell no one.
dialogue.oldrepublic.acolyte.contract: A contract bout? Good. The overseer is watching, so make it worth watching.
dialogue.oldrepublic.acolyte.wary: You're the Order's student everyone is watching. I'm watching too. Want to find out what you're worth?

npc.oldrepublic.proving_guard.bark.0: Move along. The yard is for the trained.
npc.oldrepublic.proving_guard.bark.1: Eyes forward. The Overseer is watching.
npc.oldrepublic.proving_guard.bark.2: No weapons drawn inside the gate.
npc.oldrepublic.proving_guard.bark_wary: The Order's student. Keep your hands where I can see them.
npc.oldrepublic.hub.struck.host: They turn the blow aside without looking. "Not here."
npc.oldrepublic.hub.struck.apprentice: "Hey! Training blades only, and only in a bout."
npc.oldrepublic.hub.struck.acolyte: "Ask for a bout if you want one. Do not do that again."
npc.oldrepublic.hub.struck.guard: The guard steps back and levels a rifle. "Try that again."
npc.oldrepublic.hub.struck.vendor: "Do that again and the prices go up."
vendor.oldrepublic.no_stock: This vendor has nothing to sell right now.
vendor.oldrepublic.refused.jedi_order: "The Watch's stores are not open to you."
vendor.oldrepublic.refused.sith_empire: "The Empire's stores are not open to you."

vendor.oldrepublic.refused.room: You have no room to carry that.

vendor.oldrepublic.refused.bundles: You have no bundle to break.
vendor.oldrepublic.terminal.offline: The terminal is dark. It only connects on Selvaren and Varkhast.

item.oldrepublic.kaast_pattern.desc: Teaches the Mandalorian armour patterns to an Armourcraft crafter, and is kept. Any trainer can work from it on commission.
item.oldrepublic.tomb_relic.desc: Cold, heavy, and older than the Empire. The Proving wants it.
item.oldrepublic.sealed_contract.desc: A bounty contract on you, signed only "the Buyer".
